blocks.text: Responsible gaming helps sustain PCSO’s funding for healthcare and charity by protecting players, strengthening public trust, and building institutional credibility. This was the central message of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) at the 32nd AMIC Annual International Conference on Thursday. Speaking at the Asian Media Information and Communication Centre (AMIC) conference, PCSO Assistant General Manager for Gaming, Product Development and Marketing Sector Atty. Lyssa Grace S. Pagano discussed “Promoting Good Governance through Responsible Gaming” at the Philippine Women’s University in Manila. She outlined the agency’s policy frameworks and consumer protection safeguards, emphasizing how these support the long-term sustainability of lottery […]...
